crossRefs.note: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your…
for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.
For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts…

translations.web: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
translations.bsb: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation, but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
translations.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
translations.asv: So then, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh:
